snippets.SNP_TTC_STANDARD: You have been trying to conceive long enough that a fertility assessment is usually discussed at this point.
snippets.SNP_TTC_EARLIER: With the timing you shared, earlier follow-up is usually discussed.
snippets.SNP_UNDESCENDED_TESTIS: A history of undescended testis is one reason doctors suggest a fertility review.
snippets.SNP_TORSION_INJURY_SURGERY: Past torsion, injury or surgery can affect testicular health, so review is suggested.
snippets.SNP_HERNIA_SURGERY: Hernia or genital surgery history is worth mentioning at a review.
snippets.SNP_VARICOCELE: A known varicocele is a common finding that can be assessed further.
snippets.SNP_GENITAL_INFECTION: Past genital infection or inflammation is relevant background for review.
snippets.SNP_STI: A past sexually transmitted infection is worth follow-up screening.
snippets.SNP_MUMPS: Mumps with testicular swelling is relevant background for review.
snippets.SNP_BMI: Your BMI is at a level where weight is usually discussed as part of health review.
snippets.SNP_DIABETES: Diabetes is managed together with general and reproductive health.
snippets.SNP_HYPERTENSION: Blood pressure is reviewed as part of general health.
snippets.SNP_CHOLESTEROL: Cholesterol is reviewed as part of general health.
snippets.SNP_TOBACCO: Tobacco, vaping or shisha use can affect fertility, and cutting down helps.
snippets.SNP_ALCOHOL: Regular alcohol use can affect fertility, and cutting down helps.
snippets.SNP_ANABOLIC: Steroid or testosterone products can strongly affect fertility; never stop prescribed treatment without medical advice.
snippets.SNP_SUBSTANCES: Some substances can affect fertility; support services can help.
snippets.SNP_OCCUPATIONAL: Workplace heat or chemical exposure can matter; protection and review help.
snippets.SNP_CHEMO_RADIATION: Past chemotherapy or radiation is important background for specialist review.
snippets.SNP_CHRONIC: Chronic conditions are part of the overall health picture.
snippets.SNP_SEXUAL_FUNCTION: Changes in desire or sexual function are common reasons to seek review.
snippets.SNP_ABNORMAL_SEMEN: A past abnormal semen result is usually reviewed with a specialist.
snippets.SNP_ABNORMAL_HORMONE: A past abnormal hormone result adds context for review.
snippets.SNP_FAMILY_HISTORY: Family patterns are useful background for review.
